description: Planning-only acceptance proof for targeted Lock On and reusable required-target acquisition.
planning_goal: Implement Quick Tech Lock On as a no-roll targeted canonical action: present committed Lock On with a plain Execute control; resolve an already-targeted Foundry token when exactly one valid target exists; when no target exists, acquire one by activating the Foundry token target tool and waiting for the current user's target selection; target cancellation or invalid targeting must stop execution and leave the committed entry pending; validate the selected target is within the acting mech's Sensors; execute Lock On through the canonical System Bridge -> Semantic Execution Context -> Execution Transaction -> Native Adapter spine; apply only authoritative native lockon status to the resolved target actor; mark only the exact committed Lock On entry executed after successful native status application; reuse the required-target acquisition behavior for canonical Improvised Attack without changing its native attack Flow semantics.
